title: Drone mentions vs JETS/SPY
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] GDELT GKG drone mention share 20d z-score > 1 precedes airline underperformance vs SPY (-); trade short JETS vs SPY 5d at 3d lag [gdelt.gkg.drone_share -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0064)
message: Supported-weak: drone share z>1 -> short JETS/SPY, r=-0.12 (n=389), 30 trades hit 63%, sharpe-like 0.96, OOS 10 trades hit 90%; heuristic validity 0, war likely common cause

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.drone_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short ratio:jets_spy next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control: research drone publication share (Crossref, weekly) 20d z-score > 1 should NOT predict JETS/SPY underperformance (-) if the GDELT drone signal is war-news specific; trade short JETS vs SPY 5d at 3d lag [research.drone.crossref_share -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0164)
